result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. I ran the full offline test suite and it passed. I didn't add a test for the new order, so your T-1 to T-5 example isn't checked directly.

The change is in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsInRegion` (`DataStore.java`, around line 10021). Its `ORDER BY` now uses the same `CASE t.priority …` ordering as the sales rep list, and I updated the method's comment to match. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are filtered out as before. The overview is the only caller of that method.
